entities.summary: "Guerrilla Radio" is a song by American rock band Rage Against the Machine. It was released as the lead single from their third studio album, The Battle of Los Angeles (1999). It became the band's only song to chart on the Billboard Hot 100, peaking at No. 69. The band won the Grammy Award for Best Hard Rock Performance for this song.
